summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated in-tarball payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to invoke a 727 KB obfuscated sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle written as a single line using obfuscator.io-style identifier renaming, a rotating string-array decoder (shift routine plus alphabet-based decoder), and an oversize numeric/string dictionary; the file is not referenced from any of the package's advertised SDK entry points. The declared purpose of `@or-sdk/step-templates` is an SDK library, which does not require fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time or running an opaque payload under it. The Bun invocation also intentionally evades Node-scoped runtime instrumentation. On Windows the archive is extracted via `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Expand-Archive..."`. The alternate-runtime dropper of an obfuscated blob fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
